rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by name+zip, looked up the correct delivered order, gathered available variants via tools, asked for explicit confirmation before making changes, and executed the exchange only after the user confirmed. However, it misrepresented availability and executed the wrong variant. The user requested a white, low-brightness, battery-powered desk lamp. The product data shows no such variant; the available low-battery option is silver (item 7453605304). The agent asserted the white, low, battery option was available and then executed an exchange to the silver, low, battery variant while telling the user it was white. This results in an unsupported claim, an exchange that does not match the user’s specified option, and incorrect final information, which violates the policy’s requirements for accuracy and performing the requested change correctly.
